svg.title: Published pet insurance wellness add-on ceilings and the routine dental cleaning cap
svg.desc: Two bar charts. Top: the highest annual dollar ceiling each brand prints for its top wellness tier - Fetch Prime 1,200 dollars, Nationwide 800 dollars, Spot Platinum 450 dollars summed from its printed per-item caps, Lemonade no published dollar ceiling. Bottom: routine dental cleaning cap - Fetch Prime 250 dollars, Nationwide top tier 250 dollars, Spot Platinum 150 dollars, Lemonade Preventative+ 150 dollars per year. Read from the official pages on 2026-09-28.
svg.text: What a wellness add-on pays: the ceiling each brand itself prints
Every figure was read from the brand's own official page or sample policy PDF on 2026-09-28.
Top published annual ceiling for the highest wellness tier each brand prints

g.text: not published - the guide states counts (exams, vaccines), not a dollar ceiling

svg.text: Spot prints no plan total: $450 is the sum of the 12 per-item annual maximums in its Platinum sample endorsement.
One item, four schedules: routine dental cleaning, annual maximum
Spot and Nationwide pay dental and spay/neuter from one combined line ($150 / $250); Fetch prints one combined line too ($175 / $200 / $250),
while Lemonade pays dental only in Preventative+ (routine prophylaxis, up to $150 a year) and puts spay/neuter in its other packages.
Sources: fetchpet.com/pet-insurance/wellness · spotpet.com sample Platinum endorsement PDF · petinsurance.com/petwellness/ · lemonade.com preventative care guide. Read 2026-09-28.
